clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind City, Rema Schneider needs her son Thurman’s tailoring supplies at Larson Clothiers in the Mage Quarter. He left home without his shears and needles, and Rema asks you to carry them to his workshop.

Rema Schneider worries that Thurman will fall behind in his tailoring work without his shears and needles. He left home in a rush, and his mother asks you to carry the tools across Stormwind’s canals to his workshop.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter. He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles. I know a great Adventurer like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!
Please, friend. Can you take my son's sewing kit to him? Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here to buy clothes?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, blast! I thought forgetting my kit would free me from work. Now I guess I'll have to help the Larsons with their sewing...
Oh, well. Fun will come later I guess.
